messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - FintechCorp (dedicated-vpc) potential PII in service logs. Error spike + failed redaction job. Impact: suspected customer data in raw logs stored in internal S3. Pager routed to oncall-sre and security. Link: https://infra.redwood/p/incident/1764205123 :rotating_light:

SRE-ana: on it. joining war room now. can someone grab a quick inventory of affected prefixes and which buckets contain the raw logs?

msmith: I can pull list. running quick query against logging index -> found two prefixes: fincorp-prod/streams/2026-03-15/ and fincorp-prod/archived/2026-03-10/. looks like multiple objects failed redaction due to a regex parse error in the job.

eng-ops: noted. redaction job config shows pattern mismatch for secondary email field. failing job output was written to s3://rw-logs-raw/fintechcorp/failed-redactions/ (obj count ~ 324).

SRE-ana: ok first steps: 1) isolate affected tenant logs so no further writes 2) create encrypted copy for triage (audited access only) 3) ask legal for short redaction-exception to access raw content for investigation. @legal-jdoe please advise required controls.

legal-jdoe: thanks. we can approve temporary access for incident response but must lock scope: only named reviewers, strict TTL (14 days max), immutable audit trail, no external sharing. Need list of user principals + KMS key usage. Provide reason and expected artifacts. Please red-team the privacy request.

sec-alex: also require ephemeral session creds, CloudTrail enabled for all S3 access, and preserve object checksums. We'll create a read-only detective role and enable S3 object level logging. No object should be copied out of region.

msmith: copying to a dedicated investigation bucket now with server-side-encryption + kms. command:

```
aws s3 cp s3://rw-logs-raw/fintechcorp/failed-redactions/ s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123/ --recursive --storage-class STANDARD
```

Creating IAM session for incident-role/fin-incident-read. tagging with incident=1764205123.

eng-ops: stop writes to fincorp stream: updating routing policy to route fincorp-prod -> quarantine-pool (rate 0). ran `rwctl route update --tenant fincorp-prod --dest quarantine` (ok). confirm no new objects landed after 1764205200.

customer-ops: notifying customer contacts per contract: "We’re investigating an internal logging failure that may have captured sensitive fields. We’ve quarantined their logs and will follow up within 4 hours with scope and mitigation." customer asked for timeline.

cust-support: sharing the customer-facing note to FintechCorp CISO in case legal wants changes.

SRE-ana: we've set up the incident bucket s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123 with SSE-KMS key alias/aws/redwood-incident. only principals: eng-sre:ana, eng-sre:msmith, security:alex, legal:jdoe. access granted via STS assume-role with mfa and session ttl 2h.

legal-jdoe: approve with conditions: - TTL <=14d (prefer 48h then renew), - no downloads to personal laptops, - all extracts must be hashed and stored in forensic store, - redact only returned artifacts before any external comms. document approval as legal ticket #LG-2026-129.

sec-alex: starting live redaction run on a copy. approach: run safe-redact tool that preserves structure + replaces suspect fields with [REDACTED] tokens and emits map of changed object keys. sample command:

```
./safe-redact --input s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123/ --output s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123-redacted/ --pattern-email "(?i)(?:[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,})" --concurrency 8
```

Note: tool logs will be written to /var/log/redact/incident-1764205123.log (read-only access).

msmith: running a smoke-run on 10 objects -> redaction works, sample output shows emails replaced. hashing preserved. uploading map to s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123/forensics/map-2026-03-15.json (encrypted).

SRE-ana: good. moving to coordinate legal sign-off for any further unredacted inspection. @legal-jdoe want the output artifacts to validate scope?

legal-jdoe: yes, we need sample artifacts and the process runbook. also request a short written justification from engineering stating why redaction failure occurred and what will be changed to prevent recurrence.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff in 48m. Current SRE: sre-ana. Next oncall: msmith. Please post handoff summary.

SRE-ana: handoff summary -> currently: isolated writes, created incident bucket, performed redaction smoke run, legal approved limited access (ticket LG-2026-129), security monitoring enabled. outstanding: full redaction run across ~324 objects, confirm no PII observed in more than X% of samples, prepare RCA draft. handing off to @msmith for the 16:00-00:00 shift.

msmith: ack taking over. I'll run full redaction and produce a validation report by 18:30 UTC. tagging @customer-ops for customer comms update.

customer-ops: please include estimated # of affected objects and whether any plaintext persisted in backups. we need to know if retention policies need amendment.

eng-ops: archive policy check: backups older than 30d not affected; we patched redaction job to include the missing regex and kicked a new job, but will not reprocess archived bucket without legal signoff.

legal-jdoe: if analysis shows limited exposure (emails only) we can proceed with automated redaction. if we see credentials or national id numbers, escalate to CISO + compliance and consider notifying regulators under contract clauses.

msmith: full-redact job started at 1764205800, ETA ~45m. command used:

```
./safe-redact --input s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123/ --output s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123-redacted/ --pattern-email --pattern-ssn --concurrency 16 --dry-run false
```

Progress: 120/324 objects redacted, no credential tokens found so far.

sec-alex: keep CloudTrail and object-level logs for 180 days for forensic verification (documented). tagging for sec review.

legal-jdoe: approved extension for logging retention for this incident only; legal ticket updated. no external disclosure until we confirm scope.

incident-bot: Action required: please file Post-Incident Request (PIR) and schedule follow-up with customer within 72h.

msmith: full run complete at 1764206520. results: 324 objects processed, 218 objects had email redactions, 0 objects with credential-pattern hits, 0 SSN-like matches. uploaded validation report: s3://rw-incident-fincorp-1764205123/reports/validation-2026-03-15.json.

SRE-ana: thanks. I'm closing the emergency quarantine and switching fincorp stream back to normal routing at 1764206600. please confirm no new failures in the next 30m.

customer-ops: sending customer update: "We quarantined logs, ran automated redaction, and validated outputs. No credential or SSN exposures detected. Full validation report and next steps attached." awaiting CISO ack.

legal-jdoe: good. please attach all audit trails and STS assume logs to the legal ticket. set token TTL to zero for incident-role.

sec-alex: revoking incident role and rotating KMS data key for incident bucket. starting rotation now.

cust-support: CISO ack'd receipt and appreciates quick mitigation. asked for a copy of the redacted report and timeline.

msmith: uploaded redacted artifacts to customer-approved artifact store and created signed delivery (per contract).

incident-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED (customer impact mitigated, legal sign-off obtained). Follow-ups: RCA + PIR + compliance notification if needed. Incident owner: msmith.

SRE-ana: RCA notes -> root cause: redaction regex update missed a secondary email format; postmortem items: add unit tests for regex, alert on redaction job failure with higher priority, and add canary job against recent archived objects. assigning follow-up tickets.

legal-jdoe: closing legal approval when artifacts and audit trail are in LG-2026-129.

msmith: adding final notes to thread and will publish PIR doc by EOD. thanks all. :thumbsup:
